reasons.claim: Notification is a 2.45 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Sollefteå, status notified; completed felling overlaps only 0.2% of the polygon, so it is not already felled.

Sidera lenis (VU, site-bound fungus) was recorded 164 m from the polygon edge in 2022 (uncertainty 25 m). It is forest-associated, and lack of dead wood, lack of continuity forest and soil disturbance from forestry are listed among its threats. This is one eligible species within 250 m.

Three site-bound forest NT lichens were also recorded within 250 m (Hertelidea botryosa at 100 m, Carbonicola anthracophila at 161 m, Lobaria pulmonaria at 227 m, all 2022). They are supporting evidence.
Effort around the site is adequate (164 records, 87th county percentile, above the county median of 14). Near-site, 8 records on 1 observation day lie within 250 m and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: All near-site records come from a single observation day in 2022, so they may reflect one survey visit.
Records are 100–227 m from the polygon, so they do not show that the species occupy the felling site.
Nothing was recorded inside the polygon, and only one observation day was made within 250 m.
not_established: Whether Sidera lenis or the NT lichens occur within the polygon today.
Habitat quality and dead-wood status of the stand.
Whether the felling is legal or what its effect on these species would be.
next_action: A human ecologist should review the site before felling begins. Check the 2022 record locations against the polygon boundary, and consider a field survey of the stand edge toward the records for dead wood and old trees.
